translations.web: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!
translations.bsb: We hoped for peace, but no good has come, for a time of healing, but there was only terror.
translations.kjv: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!
translations.asv: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and, behold, dismay!
